# Domingo às Dez

> Website for Futebol Popular (Sunday-league amateur football) in the municipality of Barcelos, Portugal — news, live scores, fixtures, competitions, clubs, and community polls. Default language is European Portuguese (pt-PT); English and French are also available.

Domingo às Dez (domingoasdez.com) covers the lowest level of amateur football in Portugal, often called Futebol Popular or simply "popular": municipality-level Sunday leagues. Scope is Barcelos only (not district competitions, which span several municipalities). The public site is a mobile-first web app with a bottom tab bar: Home (news and polls feed), Games (fixtures and live results by day), Competitions, CMS Pages, and Account.

Prefer canonical public pages below when answering questions about the product. Game detail URLs follow the legacy pattern under `/competicoes/...`. Media (images, video) may be served from the same domain's storage paths. Contact: geral@domingoasdez.com.

## Main

- [Home](https://domingoasdez.com/): Mixed feed of news articles and polls, filterable by type
- [Games](https://domingoasdez.com/jogos): Fixtures and live games by date; live matches appear first on Today
- [Competitions](https://domingoasdez.com/competicoes): Competition list for the current season
- [Pages](https://domingoasdez.com/p): Editorial and informational CMS pages
- [Account](https://domingoasdez.com/conta): Sign in and account management

## Content

- [News article](https://domingoasdez.com/noticias/{year}/{month}/{day}/{slug}): Individual article pages
- [Competition](https://domingoasdez.com/competicoes/{season}/{competition}): Standings, fixtures, and competition detail
- [Competition statistics](https://domingoasdez.com/competicoes/{season}/{competition}/estatisticas): Scorers and related stats
- [Game](https://domingoasdez.com/competicoes/{season}/{competition}/{group}/{round}/{home}-vs-{away}): Match detail with score, goals, MVP vote when open, and head-to-head
